{"predictors": [
{"name": "Capital Expenditure Stability", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of capital expenditures over the past 5 years, scaled by total assets, using Compustat data.", "rationale": "Firms with stable capital expenditures are better positioned to adapt to changing market conditions, leading to higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Inventory Turnover Acceleration", "construction": "Compute the difference in inventory turnover between the current year and the average of the past 3 years, using Compustat data.", "rationale": "An increase in inventory turnover indicates improving operational efficiency, which should be rewarded with higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Accounts Payable Days Deceleration", "construction": "Calculate the change in days accounts payable over the past year, using Compustat data.", "rationale": "A decrease in days accounts payable suggests deteriorating supplier relationships or reduced financial flexibility, leading to lower returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "R&D Intensity Volatility", "construction": "Compute the standard deviation of R&D expenditures over the past 5 years, scaled by sales, using Compustat data.", "rationale": "Firms with volatile R&D intensity may be pursuing riskier, higher-return projects or struggling with inconsistent innovation, leading to higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Dividend Payout Consistency", "construction": "Calculate the proportion of years with dividend payments over the past 10 years, using CRSP data.", "rationale": "Firms with consistent dividend payouts demonstrate a commitment to returning value to shareholders, which should be rewarded with higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Rate", "construction": "Compute the average annual growth rate of employees over the past 5 years, using Compustat data.", "rationale": "Firms with high employee growth rates may be expanding into new markets or increasing their market share, leading to higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supplier Concentration", "construction": "Calculate the Herfindahl index of supplier sales over the past year, using Compustat data.", "rationale": "Firms with high supplier concentration may be exposed to supply chain risks or negotiating power imbalances, leading to lower returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Environmental Liability", "construction": "Estimate the present value of potential environmental liabilities using Compustat data on environmental expenditures and liabilities.", "rationale": "Firms with high environmental liabilities may face future legal or regulatory costs, leading to lower returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Product Line Diversification", "construction": "Compute the Herfindahl index of sales by product line over the past year, using Compustat data.", "rationale": "Firms with diversified product lines may be less exposed to industry-specific risks, leading to higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Corporate Governance Quality", "construction": "Calculate a composite score based on board independence, insider ownership, and audit committee composition, using proxy statement data.", "rationale": "Firms with high-quality corporate governance may be better positioned to make value-maximizing decisions, leading to higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
